answer: In this PoA design, reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, reciprocated honest service to retain weight. EigenTrust factorization assigns freshly spawned Sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality; without trusted endorsements, their influence cannot propagate through the reciprocity-weighted trellis, whether hidden in a lagoon or dispersed like a sparrow, and they cannot pass consensus.
